context:
Found during the autogenerated-issue remediation batch (program item autogen-issues-closeout-20261018, 2026-10-20). Evidence is from that session; line numbers and counts are leads to re-verify before editing. Not part of the batch set; unclaimed.

### Completion Evidence (2026-10-20)
Timeline (2026-10-18 UTC): producer run 39137257094 created 14:43:14; dispatch step (inside the build job) finished 14:45:54-55; job completedAt 14:45:58 (only two jobs, report-failed-bundle skipped); consumer run 39137456105 created 14:45:56, started polling 14:46:15, logged "producing run concluded null" 14:47:37 (about 82 s of polling); producer run conclusion success appeared 14:56:34, 10 min 36 s after its last job ended.
Findings: the dispatch inside the job explains only a 3-4 s window, not 10 min; no step was running, so the lag is GitHub-side run-conclusion latency [INFERENCE: GitHub internal state not visible]. 14 site-inputs runs of 2026-10-20 all concluded within 4-6 min of creation, so it is not reproducible. The consumer gave up after about 82 s because site PR 47 (bounded 10-minute monotonic wait) was not merged yet at that run. Moving the dispatch to a second job would not help (a run concludes only after every job).
Decision: documented as intended design; no workflow change. The 10-minute cap would have been 19 s short for this one outlier; a longer cap was not chosen on a single observation. Failure stays loud and the relay opens/updates an issue (classified producer-not-concluded); a failed or cancelled producer is never treated as success (unchanged). Residual risk: rare platform lag over the cap fails a deploy; a rerun recovers. Revisit the cap if a second occurrence appears.
description: Site deploy run 39137456105 failed with "bundle:fetch: producing run concluded null" while the producer, core site-inputs run 39137257094, only got its conclusion about 9 minutes later. The site now waits up to 10 minutes of monotonic time for completion (site PR 47), but the delay itself is unexplained: the workflow dispatches from inside its own build job, which may mean the run is not yet completed when the consumer starts. Work: check the dispatch point in site-inputs.yml against run timestamps; if the dispatch happens before the job ends, move it or document it. Guardrail: do not treat a failed producer as success.
